message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  

If you need the most up‑to‑date figure, you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | How to find the price |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Bloomberg** | Search “Gold Spot” on Bloomberg.com or the Bloomberg terminal. |
| **Reuters** | Look up “Gold Spot” on Reuters.com or the Reuters terminal. |
| **Kitco** | Visit Kitco.com and view the “Gold” section; they publish the current spot price in real time. |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | Their “Gold Price” page shows the official London Gold Fixing. |
| **U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve** | Occasionally publish commodity prices in their weekly reports. |

These sites typically quote the price in U.S. dollars per troy ounce. If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also use a financial news app (e.g., CNBC, Yahoo Finance) or a search engine query like “gold price now” which will pull the latest figure from one of the above sources.
